articles.title: RSA Launches Agent ID Platform to Secure AI Agents and MCP Servers
articles.summary:

articles.title: RATHat Android Malware Uses Gemini AI to Control Phones Outside Normal App Permissions
articles.summary:

articles.title: AI Agent Finds Linux Kernel Bug That Turns a Tiny Memory Write Into Root Access
articles.summary:
Autonomous security research platform XBOW has disclosed CVE-2026-72018, a high-severity Linux kernel vulnerability that converts a tightly constrained out-of-bounds memory write into local root access. The flaw affects the DIBS loopback implementation used by the SMC-D shared-memory communication path, where a missing bounds check allows attacker-controlled data to be copied beyond an allocated kernel buffer. articles.title: New OperTraitors Tool Reveals Dangerous Privilege Escalation Paths in Kubernetes Operators
articles.summary:
A new open-source security tool, OperTraitor, has revealed how Kubernetes operators can create dangerous privilege escalation paths when they receive excessive role-based access control permissions. The tool analyzes operator manifests and compares their documented function with the permissions actually granted to their service accounts. articles.title: MCP Python SDK OAuth Flaw Lets Malicious Servers Hijack AI Agent Accounts
articles.summary:
A high-severity flaw in the official Model Context Protocol (MCP) Python SDK could allow a malicious MCP server to steal OAuth authentication material and take over AI agent accounts. The issue affects vulnerable HTTP-based MCP clients that connect to untrusted servers while using OAuth to access legitimate identity providers such as Google, Okta, or Microsoft […]
